title: HoloMap: Progression
summary: Upgrade HoloMap in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Upgrade Path
blocks.body: Progress by moving from decoration to decisions. Add route overlays, waypoints, region context, resource marks, and staging notes that change what you carry.

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step is usually boring because it is the safety layer: storage, markers, meters, counters, backups, or notes. Build that layer before raising the risk.

blocks.title: Ready For More
blocks.body: You are ready to push HoloMap further when the current loop feels repeatable, the failure signs are familiar, and the next upgrade has a clear purpose.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
